verses.text: The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
lines: The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness;
the world, and those who dwell in it.

verses.text: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.
lines: For he has founded it on the seas,
and established it on the floods.

verses.text: Who may ascend to Yahweh’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?
lines: Who may ascend to Yahweh’s hill?
Who may stand in his holy place?

verses.text: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
lines: He who has clean hands and a pure heart;
who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood,
and has not sworn deceitfully.

verses.text: He shall receive a blessing from Yahweh, righteousness from the God of his salvation.
lines: He shall receive a blessing from Yahweh,
righteousness from the God of his salvation.

verses.text: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob.
lines: This is the generation of those who seek Him,
who seek your face—even Jacob.

verses.text: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
lines: Lift up your heads, you gates!
Be lifted up, you everlasting doors,
and the King of glory will come in.

verses.text: Who is the King of glory? Yahweh strong and mighty, Yahweh mighty in battle.
lines: Who is the King of glory?
Yahweh strong and mighty,
Yahweh mighty in battle.

verses.text: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
lines: Lift up your heads, you gates;
yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors,
and the King of glory will come in.

verses.text: Who is this King of glory? Yahweh of Armies is the King of glory!
lines: Who is this King of glory?
Yahweh of Armies is the King of glory!
